description: Hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models, with hot experts on the GPU and cold ones streamed from NVMe
notes: The launcher and model tools need Python 3; run 'scoop install python' or install it from python.org.
Models are downloaded separately. Run 'coli setup' and keep at least 22 GB free on disk.
This archive runs on the CPU and Vulkan. Upstream also publishes a CUDA build for NVIDIA GPUs.
